name: Name tag: editorial card, refined
when: A character's first strong appearance. The shot steps back into a photo on the right and pushes in on the face; the name and role are one block on the left, centred on the photo. Under the scene the footage is the same shot, heavily blurred and brought to a steady mid level whatever its exposure (`ground`); right after the scene it cuts back to the sharp shot.
anchor: The scene starts on the character's name: the shot starts to step back 17 frames in, the name rises from frame 24.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.shot: the clip of the person: the same shot as the footage at this moment, cut to the scene's length, in the project's assets/. Pick a shot where the face is clearly visible
vars.name1: the name's first line (shown in capitals), 7 characters at most
vars.name2: the name's second line, 7 characters at most; empty = one line
vars.role1: the role's first line, 26 characters at most; empty = no role
vars.role2: the role's second line, 26 characters at most; empty = one line
vars.faceX: the centre of the face, x in px on the 1920x1080 shot: the photo pushes in on it. Read it off a snapshot; 80 px off still works
vars.faceY: the centre of the face, y in px
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave; the shot is full frame again 0.4 s later and the scene ends on it at 0.43 s (default: scene length - 0.43)

source: algrow-gta-pipeline/lab/newanims/kit/templates/nametag-C2 (validated as nametag-C2 on 16 Nov; replaces the first editorial card, kept in lab/retired/nametag-C-v1)
changed: Reworked on 16 Nov after a dark shot turned the first version into a muddy card: the ground is levelled to a steady mid tone (no warm wash), the photo pushes in on the face (faceX/faceY), name and role are one block centred on the photo, and the type and photo leave together.
